title: Masha and these Bears
clean_text: Cleaned sample summary based on Kaspersky Securelist's 2018 report Masha and these Bears. The report treats Sofacy as the same actor family commonly tracked as APT28, Fancy Bear, and Tsar Team. It discusses SPLM, also called CHOPSTICK or XAgent, as a selective second-stage tool, and describes Zebrocy activity alongside SPLM. The report highlights targeting activity in Central and East Asia, including China and military or foreign affairs related organizations.
